body.p: A STRANGE BLADE.—An American Rough, whose name is Walt Whitman, and who calls himself a "Kosmos," has been publishing a mad book under the title of "Leaves of Grass." We can only say that these "Leaves of Grass" are fully worthy to be put on a level with that heap of rubbish called "Fern Leaves," by Fanny Fern, and similarly "green stuff." The fields of American literature want weeding dreadfully.
